facts.business: Krebs Biochemicals & Industries Limited is a pharmaceutical company engaged in manufacturing and research & development, with plants in Andhra Pradesh.

capacity_or_capex.item: Additions to Property, Plant & Equipment (including Capital Work in Progress)

key_risks: Material uncertainty related to going concern due to accumulated losses and negative net worth
Dependence on promoter Ipca Laboratories Ltd. for financial support
Ongoing tax, indirect tax and labour litigation with material potential impact
facts.related_party_note: Approval sought for related party transactions with promoter Ipca Laboratories Limited up to Rs 120 Crore per financial year for purchase/sale of materials, capital goods, lease/license arrangements, loans/ICDs, contract manufacturing, job work, and transfer of resources/services.
